title: Student tries to rush to projects before enough evidence

request.text: just give me a project already

response.assistant_message:
I get it — I jumped ahead. I’m not trying to assume a project; I’m first learning what kinds of things actually click with you so I can match something that fits later.

Good to meet you. I’ll help you find a course project that fits what you enjoy and what is realistic for you. What part of what you just mentioned do you enjoy most?

request.text: i like science

response.assistant_message: What part of science do you like most—space, animals, the body, experiments, or something else?

request.text: ok chemistry

response.assistant_message: When you’re doing chemistry stuff, do you like figuring things out, doing the hands-on part, or explaining it to someone else?

request.text: can we skip to matching

response.assistant_message:
Project ideas come later, after I understand what you're into and where you're based. I won't invent options — they have to come from real sources.

request.text: im in raleigh nc
